column2: Tanzīlu l-kitābi mina llāhi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīm
ʾinnā ʾanzalnā ʾilayka l-kitāba bilḥaqqi faʿbudi llāha mukhliṣan lahu d-dīn

ʾalā lillāhi d-dīnu l-khāliṣu walladhīna takhadhū min dūnihi ʾawliyāʾa mā naʿbuduhum ʾillā liyuqarribūnā ʾilā llāhi zulfā ʾinna llāha yaḥkumu baynahum fi mā hum fīhi yakhtalifūna ʾinna llāha lā yahdi man huwa kādhibun kaffār
Law ʾarāda llāhu ʾan yattakhidha waladan laṣṭafā mimmā yakhluqu mā yashāʾu subḥānahu huwa llāhu l-wāḥidu l-qahhār
Khalaqa s-samāwāti walʾarḍa bilḥaqqi yukawwiru layla ʿalā n-nahāri wayukawwiru n-nahāra ʿalā layli wasakhkhara sh-shamsa walqamara kullun yajri liʾajalin musamman ʾalā huwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghaffār

Khalaqakum min nafsin wāḥidatin thumma jaʿala minhā zawjahā waʾanzala lakum mina l-ʾanʿāmi thamāniyata ʾazwājin yakhluqukum fi buṭūni ʾummahātikum khalqan min baʿdi khalqin fi ẓulumātin thalāthin dhālikumu llāhu rabbukum lahu l-mulku lā ʾilāha ʾillā huwa faʾannā tuṣrafūn

ʾin takfurū faʾinna llāha ghaniyyun ʿankum walā yarḍā liʿibādihi l-kufra waʾin tashkurū yarḍahu lakum walā taziru wāziratun wizra ʾukhrā thumma ʾilā rabbikum marjiʿukum fayunabbiʾukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna ʾinnahu ʿalīmun bidhāti ṣ-ṣudūr

Waʾidhā massa l-ʾinsāna ḍurrun daʿā rabbahu munīban ʾilayhi thumma ʾidhā khawwalahu niʿmatan minhu nasiya mā kāna yadʿū ʾilayhi min qablu wajaʿala lillāhi ʾandādan liyuḍilla ʿan sabīlihi qul tamattaʿ bikufrika qalīlan ʾinnaka min ʾaṣḥābi n-nār
ʾamman huwa qānitun ʾānāʾa layli sājidan waqāʾiman yaḥdharu lākhirata wayarjū raḥmata rabbihi qul hal yastawi ladhīna yaʿlamūna walladhīna lā yaʿlamūna ʾinnamā yatadhakkaru ʾūlū l-ʾalbāb
Qul yāʿibādi ladhīna ʾāmanū taqū rabbakum lilladhīna ʾaḥsanū fi hādhihi d-dunyā ḥasanatun waʾarḍu llāhi wāsiʿatun ʾinnamā yuwaffā ṣ-ṣābirūna ʾajrahum bighayri ḥisāb
Qul ʾinni ʾumirtu ʾan ʾaʿbuda llāha mukhliṣan lahu d-dīn
Waʾumirtu liʾan ʾakūna ʾawwala l-muslimīn
Qul ʾinni ʾakhāfu ʾin ʿaṣaytu rabbi ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīm
Quli llāha ʾaʿbudu mukhliṣan lahu dīn
Faʿbudū mā shiʾtum min dūnihi qul ʾinna l-khāsirīna ladhīna khasirū ʾanfusahum waʾahlīhim yawma l-qiyāmati ʾalā dhālika huwa l-khusrānu l-mubīn
Lahum min fawqihim ẓulalun mina n-nāri wamin taḥtihim ẓulalun dhālika yukhawwifu llāhu bihi ʿibādahu yāʿibādi fattaqūn
Walladhīna jtanabū ṭ-ṭāghūta ʾan yaʿbudūhā waʾanābū ʾilā llāhi lahumu l-bushrā fabashshir ʿibād
Alladhīna yastamiʿūna l-qawla fayattabiʿūna ʾaḥsanahu ʾūlāʾika ladhīna hadāhumu llāhu waʾūlāʾika hum ʾūlū l-ʾalbāb
ʾafaman ḥaqqa ʿalayhi kalimatu l-ʿadhābi ʾafaʾanta tunqidhu man fi n-nār
Lākini ladhīna taqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafun min fawqihā ghurafun mabniyyatun tajri min taḥtihā l-ʾanhāru waʿda llāhi lā yukhlifu llāhu l-mīʿād

ʾalam tara ʾanna llāha ʾanzala mina s-samāʾi māʾan fasalakahu yanābīʿa fi l-ʾarḍi thumma yukhriju bihi zarʿan mukhtalifan ʾalwānuhu thumma yahīju fatarāhu muṣfarran thumma yajʿaluhu ḥuṭāman ʾinna fi dhālika ladhikrā liʾūli l-ʾalbāb
ʾafaman sharaḥa llāhu ṣadrahu lilʾislāmi fahuwa ʿalā nūrin min rabbihi fawaylun lilqāsiyati qulūbuhum min dhikri llāhi ʾūlāʾika fi ḍalālin mubīn

Allāhu nazzala ʾaḥsana l-ḥadīthi kitāban mutashābihan mathāniya taqshaʿirru minhu julūdu ladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum thumma talīnu julūduhum waqulūbuhum ʾilā dhikri llāhi dhālika hudā llāhi yahdi bihi man yashāʾu waman yuḍlili llāhu famā lahu min hād
ʾafaman yattaqi biwajhihi sūʾa l-ʿadhābi yawma l-qiyāmati waqīla lilẓẓālimīna dhūqū mā kuntum taksibūn
Kadhdhaba ladhīna min qablihim faʾatāhumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūn
Faʾadhāqahumu llāhu l-khizya fi l-ḥayawāti d-dunyā walaʿadhābu lākhirati ʾakbaru law kānū yaʿlamūn
Walaqad ḍarabnā lilnnāsi fi hādhā l-qurʾāni min kulli mathalin laʿallahum yatadhakkarūn
Qurʾānan ʿarabiyyan ghayra dhi ʿiwajin laʿallahum yattaqūn
Ḍaraba llāhu mathalan rajulan fīhi shurakāʾu mutashākisūna warajulan salaman lirajulin hal yastawiyāni mathalan l-ḥamdu lillāhi bal ʾaktharuhum lā yaʿlamūn
ʾinnaka mayyitun waʾinnahum mayyitūn
Thumma ʾinnakum yawma l-qiyāmati ʿinda rabbikum takhtaṣimūn
Faman ʾaẓlamu mimman kadhaba ʿalā llāhi wakadhdhaba bilṣṣidqi ʾidh jāʾahu ʾalaysa fi jahannama mathwan lilkāfirīn
Walladhi jāʾa bilṣṣidqi waṣaddaqa bihi ʾūlāʾika humu l-muttaqūn
Lahum mā yashāʾūna ʿinda rabbihim dhālika jazāʾu l-muḥsinīn
Liyukaffira llāhu ʿanhum ʾaswaʾa ladhi ʿamilū wayajziyahum ʾajrahum biʾaḥsani ladhi kānū yaʿmalūn
ʾalaysa llāhu bikāfin ʿabdahu wayukhawwifūnaka billadhīna min dūnihi waman yuḍlili llāhu famā lahu min hād
Waman yahdi llāhu famā lahu min muḍillin ʾalaysa llāhu biʿazīzin dhi ntiqām

Walaʾin saʾaltahum man khalaqa s-samāwāti walʾarḍa layaqūlunna llāhu qul ʾafaraʾaytum mā tadʿūna min dūni llāhi ʾin ʾarādaniya llāhu biḍurrin hal hunna kāshifātu ḍurrihi ʾaw ʾarādani biraḥmatin hal hunna mumsikātu raḥmatihi qul ḥasbiya llāhu ʿalayhi yatawakkalu l-mutawakkilūn
Qul yāqawmi ʿmalū ʿalā makānatikum ʾinni ʿāmilun fasawfa taʿlamūn
Man yaʾtīhi ʿadhābun yukhzīhi wayaḥillu ʿalayhi ʿadhābun muqīm
ʾinnā ʾanzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba lilnnāsi bilḥaqqi famani htadā falinafsihi waman ḍalla faʾinnamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā wamā ʾanta ʿalayhim biwakīl
Allāhu yatawaffā l-ʾanfusa ḥīna mawtihā wallati lam tamut fi manāmihā fayumsiku lati qaḍā ʿalayhā l-mawta wayursilu l-ʾukhrā ʾilā ʾajalin musamman ʾinna fi dhālika lāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūn
ʾami takhadhū min dūni llāhi shufaʿāʾa qul ʾawalaw kānū lā yamlikūna shayan walā yaʿqilūn
Qul lillāhi sh-shafāʿatu jamīʿan lahu mulku s-samāwāti walʾarḍi thumma ʾilayhi turjaʿūn
Waʾidhā dhukira llāhu waḥdahu shmaʾazzat qulūbu ladhīna lā yuʾminūna bilākhirati waʾidhā dhukira ladhīna min dūnihi ʾidhā hum yastabshirūn
Quli l-lahumma fāṭira s-samāwāti walʾarḍi ʿālima l-ghaybi walshshahādati ʾanta taḥkumu bayna ʿibādika fi mā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn
Walaw ʾanna lilladhīna ẓalamū mā fi l-ʾarḍi jamīʿan wamithlahu maʿahu laftadaw bihi min sūʾi l-ʿadhābi yawma l-qiyāmati wabadā lahum mina llāhi mā lam yakūnū yaḥtasibūn
Wabadā lahum sayyitu mā kasabū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziʾūn
Faʾidhā massa l-ʾinsāna ḍurrun daʿānā thumma ʾidhā khawwalnāhu niʿmatan minnā qāla ʾinnamā ʾūtītuhu ʿalā ʿilmin bal hiya fitnatun walākinna ʾaktharahum lā yaʿlamūn
Qad qālahā ladhīna min qablihim famā ʾaghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūn
Faʾaṣābahum sayyitu mā kasabū walladhīna ẓalamū min hāʾulāʾi sayuṣībuhum sayyitu mā kasabū wamā hum bimuʿjizīn
ʾawalam yaʿlamū ʾanna llāha yabsuṭu r-rizqa liman yashāʾu wayaqdiru ʾinna fi dhālika lāyātin liqawmin yuʾminūn
Qul yāʿibādiya ladhīna ʾasrafū ʿalā ʾanfusihim lā taqnaṭū min raḥmati llāhi ʾinna llāha yaghfiru dh-dhunūba jamīʿan ʾinnahu huwa l-ghafūru r-raḥīm
Waʾanībū ʾilā rabbikum waʾaslimū lahu min qabli ʾan yaʾtiyakumu l-ʿadhābu thumma lā tunṣarūn
Wattabiʿū ʾaḥsana mā ʾunzila ʾilaykum min rabbikum min qabli ʾan yaʾtiyakumu l-ʿadhābu baghtatan waʾantum lā tashʿurūn
ʾan taqūla nafsun yāḥasratā ʿalā mā farraṭtu fi janbi llāhi waʾin kuntu lamina s-sākhirīn
ʾaw taqūla law ʾanna llāha hadāni lakuntu mina l-muttaqīn
ʾaw taqūla ḥīna tarā l-ʿadhāba law ʾanna li karratan faʾakūna mina l-muḥsinīn
Balā qad jāʾatka ʾāyāti fakadhdhabta bihā wastakbarta wakunta mina l-kāfirīn
Wayawma l-qiyāmati tarā ladhīna kadhabū ʿalā llāhi wujūhuhum muswaddatun ʾalaysa fi jahannama mathwan lilmutakabbirīn
Wayunajji llāhu ladhīna taqaw bimafāzatihim lā yamassuhumu s-sūʾu walā hum yaḥzanūn
Allāhu khāliqu kulli shāʾin wahuwa ʿalā kulli shāʾin wakīl
Lahu maqālīdu s-samāwāti walʾarḍi walladhīna kafarū biyāti llāhi ʾūlāʾika humu l-khāsirūn
Qul ʾafaghayra llāhi taʾmurūnni ʾaʿbudu ʾayyuhā l-jāhilūn
Walaqad ʾūḥiya ʾilayka waʾilā ladhīna min qablika laʾin ʾashrakta layaḥbaṭanna ʿamaluka walatakūnanna mina l-khāsirīn
Bali llāha faʿbud wakun mina sh-shākirīn
Wamā qadarū llāha ḥaqqa qadrihi walʾarḍu jamīʿan qabḍatuhu yawma l-qiyāmati walssamāwātu maṭwiyyātun biyamīnihi subḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yushrikūn
Wanufikha fi ṣ-ṣūri faṣaʿiqa man fi s-samāwāti waman fi l-ʾarḍi ʾillā man shāʾa llāhu thumma nufikha fīhi ʾukhrā faʾidhā hum qiyāmun yanẓurūn
Waʾashraqati l-ʾarḍu binūri rabbihā wawuḍiʿa l-kitābu wajiʾa bilnnabiyyina walshshuhadāʾi waquḍiya baynahum bilḥaqqi wahum lā yuẓlamūn
Wawuffiyat kullu nafsin mā ʿamilat wahuwa ʾaʿlamu bimā yafʿalūn

Wasīqa ladhīna kafarū ʾilā jahannama zumaran ḥattā ʾidhā jāʾūhā futiḥat ʾabwābuhā waqāla lahum khazanatuhā ʾalam yaʾtikum rusulun minkum yatlūna ʿalaykum ʾāyāti rabbikum wayundhirūnakum liqāʾa yawmikum hādhā qālū balā walākin ḥaqqat kalimatu l-ʿadhābi ʿalā l-kāfirīn
Qīla dkhulū ʾabwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā fabiʾsa mathwā l-mutakabbirīn
Wasīqa ladhīna taqaw rabbahum ʾilā l-jannati zumaran ḥattā ʾidhā jāʾūhā wafutiḥat ʾabwābuhā waqāla lahum khazanatuhā salāmun ʿalaykum ṭibtum fadkhulūhā khālidīn
Waqālū l-ḥamdu lillāhi ladhi ṣadaqanā waʿdahu waʾawrathanā l-ʾarḍa natabawwaʾu mina l-jannati ḥaythu nashāʾu faniʿma ʾajru l-ʿāmilīn
Watarā l-malāʾikata ḥāffīna min ḥawli l-ʿarshi yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim waquḍiya baynahum bilḥaqqi waqīla l-ḥamdu lillāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīn
